description.en: Same as AddParty_Message, but without fading/stopping the current BGM (passes -1 for both the fade and wait durations).
Param ID of the character to add to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's Fighting Spirit.
Whether to lock the member's Fighting Spirit.
Level to set for the new member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Adding a member without changing their level (real usage, from ev42012500.nut)
examples.code:
// Add a party member with the recruitment presentation, without fading the BGM, keeping their current level
AddParty_Message_NoFadeBGM("para_cp0005", true, false, false);

examples.case: Adding a member and setting their level (real usage, from ev42082500.nut)
examples.code:
// Add a party member with the recruitment presentation, without fading the BGM, and set their level to 25
AddParty_Message_NoFadeBGM("para_cp0016", true, false, false, 25);
